title: Unit 2 Test
description:
What should I study?

 

The test will cover:

 * Ionic Compounds (Ionic bonds) vs Molecular Compounds (Covalent bonds) 
 * Lewis Dot diagrams for molecules
 * Naming compounds (ionic and molecular)
 * Molecular Shapes and VSEPR theory
 * Bond Polarity vs Molecular Polarity
 * Like Dissolves Like and Molecules are Sticky (IMA's)

**Review the notes on all these topics.

 

I will add some Optional Activities and answer keys into our Unit 2 folder.

 

There is also a folder with "Helpful Videos". Watch some of these if you are  
struggling with the concepts. I will add more when I find some good ones. - Link: http://troyschools.schoology.com/assignment/8610781800
